newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish electric gauge maker sees listing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Polish electric gauge maker sees listing in 1997.

text.p: Polish electric devices producer Apator Torun SA wants to issue between 600,000 and 800,000 shares and is aiming for a bourse listing early in 1997, a company official said on Wednesday.
Kazimierz Piotrowski, Apator's administrative director, told Reuters the company wanted to enter the main market of the Warsaw bourse.
"Apator applied to the Polish Securities Commission on September 30 to clear shares of the new issue and existing shares for public trade," he said.
"We plan to enter the bourse's main market late January or early February," he added.
Piotrowski also said the funds from the new issue would be earmarked for investments, modernisation and the purchase of new technologies.

Apator, based in Torun, northern Poland, employs 1,150 and expects to net five million zlotys this year on 75-million-zloty-sales, up from last year's 4.4-million-zloty net on sales of 62 million zlotys.
